name: claude-trading-skills
description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
one_liner: A set of Claude Code skills that walk a part-time investor through a disciplined morning market review, screening, and trade-planning routine instead of trading on gut feel.
buyer: A time-constrained individual investor who swing-trades on the side of a day job and wants a repeatable, disciplined process rather than a signal service.
business_use_cases: A part-time swing trader runs the morning market-review skill before work to get a disciplined pre-market checklist instead of guessing.
A financial newsletter writer uses the screener skill to generate a daily watchlist for subscribers.
A trading educator packages the skillset into a paid course that teaches retail traders to use AI for process and journaling, not for signals.

money_ideas.idea: A paid 'pro' skill pack with extra screeners and structured journaling templates
A subscription newsletter or Discord built on the daily screener output

steal_this: Package the screener and morning-review skills into a $9 Gumroad kit for retail traders this weekend.
